SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign reading 6.2.2 Reading syllables (ma-mu, pa-pu), part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Which syllables can you recall? 2. Where can we read syllables from?

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign reading 6.2.2 Reading syllables (ma-mu, pa-pu) together.

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: exploration skills as learner explores more on reading of syllables.

● Self-efficacy as learner reads syllables correctly.
